svg.title: A terminal typing out what this account is for
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 🧮 Risk measured, not guessed / 🧹 Automating the step everyone skips / 🌱 Nothing here ages without warning / ♻️ Environments that nobody has to remember / 📊 Runs you can rerun later / ⛓️ A rule that cannot rot quietly / 🧾 A log line that says who to ask / 💤 Builds that do not wake anyone / 🎓 Only what the next reader needs / 📖 Runbooks nobody can ignore / 🗓️ Renewed on a schedule, not a reminder / 🔋 A runbook that outlasts the team
